senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="P00970">same</cite> Targ. II Esth. VI, 10.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 12:7">Targ. I Kings XII, 7</cite>.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 34:5">Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 5</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="P00989"><he>עַנְיָינִי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 102:3">Ib. CII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:10:3">Y. Succ. III, 54ᵃ</cite> top <he>מה נַעְנֵי</he> what shall we say in response? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:10:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ יונה ע׳ הכין והכין</he> R. J. responded, so be it, and so be it.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:16">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אימא אלהא דמאיר עֲנֵנִי</he> say, O God of Meïr, hear me; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Menachot 17a:7">Men. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>עני מרי</he>, v. <cite ref="P00227"><he>עֲנֵי</he> II</cite>.]

senses.gloss: to speak or sing in chorus; to respond.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:21">Targ. O. Ex. XV, 21</cite>. Targ. II Esth. VI, 11.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:13">Targ. Prov. XXI, 13</cite> <he>נתעני</he> ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. <he>נַעֲנוֹי</he> will answer him; h. text <cite ref="J00491"><he>יֵעָנֶה</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: (euphem.) to be gratified, be eased. Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ bot. ההן דאזיל ולא מִתְעַנֵּי … he who went out to ease his bowels without success; [perhaps to be read מתפני, v. פְּנֵי?]
